_meta.vessel: 2021 Boston Whaler 270 Dauntless — Twin Mercury Verado 300
_meta.note: Knowledge-base service intervals with the associated MarineMax part for each item.

intervals.notes: FC-W certified 25W-40 marine oil. Change both engines together.

intervals.item: Lower unit gear lube change (each engine)
intervals.notes: Milky/gray fluid signals a failed seal. Change both engines together.
Primary water-separation barrier. Inspect bowl monthly.
Critical cooling component. Failure causes overheating and weak tell-tale.
Iridium plugs per Verado spec. Eight plugs per engine.

intervals.item: Steering cable / hydraulic steering fluid check
intervals.notes: Check SeaStar hydraulic fluid annually; bleed if spongy.
Dual-battery system. Clean terminals; apply dielectric grease.
Replace when 50% depleted. Critical in saltwater and brackish water.
Inspect both props. Stainless dings can be repaired.
Wheel bearings are the most common trailer failure.
